title: Two knights cannot force mate
line: Against a bare king, the defender always has a way out.

steps.text: Two knights and a king cannot force mate. The defender only has to avoid stepping into one.
If your king steps into the corner, a knight jump gives mate. Tap the square that knight jumps to.
steps.hint: The knight that is not checking you now.
steps.after: From there the knight checks the corner, and every other square is covered.

steps.text: Mate needs a check. Here White covered the last square without check: Black has no move, and it is stalemate.
You are in check. Step away from the corner.

wrong.g8h8: That walks into mate: the other knight jumps in with check.

steps.hint: The other square, away from the corner.
steps.after: No mate is possible here. Keep doing this, and the game is a draw.

summary: Two knights cannot force mate on a bare king. Only step into a corner when no knight can check you there.
